confidence.description: 0..1; GLM-5.3 (max reasoning) sometimes emits a string (e.g. "0.85") — the Go post-check normalizes it to a number

value_string.description: improved scalar text value (title, about); null when unchanged or not a string field

value_strings.description: improved list value (key skills); null when unchanged or not a list field

value_amount.description: improved numeric value (salary amount); null when unchanged or not a numeric field

name.description: the key skill the level belongs to (an ADDED skill)

key_skill_levels.description: T57: ownership levels for ADDED key skills; absent = every added skill defaults to Средний (backward compatible)

missing_data.description: array of strings; GLM-5.3 sometimes emits a plain string — the Go post-check normalizes it to a one-element array
